newsitem.title: USA: NHL ICE HOCKEY-SAN JOSE SHARKS FIRE COACH AL SIMS.
newsitem.headline: NHL ICE HOCKEY-SAN JOSE SHARKS FIRE COACH AL SIMS.

text.p: The San Jose Sharks became the fourth NHL team since the end of the regular season to fire a coach when they dismissed Al Sims after just one year behind the bench.
The 44-year-old Sims joins Boston's Steve Kasper, Montreal's Mario Tremblay and Phoenix's Don Hay as coaches who have been dumped since April 18.
The Sharks finished last in the Western Conference for the second straight season with a 27-47-8 record and their 62 points was one better than the Boston Bruins for the worst mark in the NHL.
Assistant coaches Wayne Cashman and Roy Sommer were retained and Cashman is a candidate to succeed Sims, general manager Dean Lombardi said.

San Jose ranked last in the league with 211 goals and 24th with 278 goals against. The Sharks finished 19 points out of the last Western Conference playoff spot and were the first team in the NHL eliminated from postseason contention.
Sims, a former NHL defenceman, was hired by the Sharks after three seasons as an assistant with the Mighty Ducks of Anaheim.
